source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.7, printed pages 79-84, in the book's order.

blocks.text: Aap jante hain ke cells ke andar aur bahar cheezon (substances) ka aana jana cell ke kaamon ke liye bohat zaroori hai. Yeh aamad-o-raft nutrients lene, waste nikalne, gases ke tabadle (gas exchange) aur signal transduction ke liye hoti hai. Cells is aamad-o-raft ko control karne ke liye plasma membrane par bharosa karte hain. Membrane transport mechanisms (membrane ke aar-paar le jane ke tareeqe) cell ko homeostasis qaim rakhne, nutrients lene, waste nikalne aur apne mahol se rabta rakhne ke qabil banate hain.
Cell ke mahol ke saath cheezon ka len-den karte hue plasma membrane cell ke andar aur bahar dono taraf equilibrium (tawazun, barabari) qaim rakhti hai.
Yeh tareeqe do qisam ke hain: passive transport (jis mein energy nahi lagti) aur active transport (jis mein energy lagti hai).
